methods.what: Linear change of four theta characteristic variables (Hadamard-type half-sum substitution) and its inverse
Parametrisation of m by λ so that m and m-1 are squares
Rationalising relation among square roots of products
Genus / branch-point count for plane curve of degrees m,n
